intro.text: Allriandre's young daughter, small for her age, shy around strangers but at ease with her mother.

items.text: Ruri lived alone with her mother, who worked at the forges and left her with their landlady, Miss Coussaint, a woman who frightened her. When the landlady caught Ruri painting the wall with toothpaste and began shouting, Allriandre came home, waited for her to go, and helped Ruri finish the picture. When visitors came about Wayne's estate, Ruri curled up in her mother's lap and smeared toothpaste on the note Wayne had left.
